Subject: Kickoff: Procurement onboarding for Arcadia Tech — doc swap & owner matrix

Hi Liam / Arcadia procurement team,

Thanks for taking the time today — excited to get Arcadia set up. To speed vendor activation on our side, here's a short checklist of what we need from you and what we will provide. If you prefer to share via your portal link, that's fine (please paste the link in reply).

What we need from you (please return in this thread if possible):
- Completed W-9 (PDF) or equivalent tax form for US entities
- ACH/bank remit instructions (vendor ACH form or bank letter)
- Official legal entity name and address for the vendor record
- Primary billing contact + billing email for PO/invoice routing
- Signed SOW (if you have a draft) or scope summary to attach to the PO
- Proof of insurance (COI) and relevant compliance attestations
- Any vendor questionnaire / privacy/security responses (if you have a completed pack)

What we'll provide / next steps from Redwood:
- Vendor intake matrix template (attached) for quick field mapping
- Redwood vendor registration form and instructions for finance
- PO process summary and standard Net terms (we typically process Net 30)
- DocuSign link for final MSA/SOW once terms are agreed
- Point of contact: me (Camila) for activation and Marissa for billing follow-up

Timeline: if we can receive the documents within 5 business days we can aim to have a vendor record and an initial PO within ~7-10 business days, pending finance review. If you need faster activation, let me know and I will escalate with Ops.

Attached: vendor_intake_matrix.xlsx (template) — please fill the highlighted fields and attach W-9 + bank details when ready.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you live.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
